title: Understanding Distributed File Systems
text: Distributed file systems are designed to handle large amounts of data by spreading it across multiple machines. This can lead to faster data access and redundancy, but it also introduces some complexities.

title: Comparing Read Speeds
text: Consider the factors that affect read speeds in distributed systems versus single drives. Think about network latency, parallel processing, and data locality.

hintAnswer: Parallel processing and data redundancy can lead to faster read speeds in distributed systems.

title: Network Latency Considerations
text: While distributed systems can be faster due to parallel processing, network latency can sometimes slow down data retrieval. Consider how this might affect overall read speeds.
